We are a technology-driven leader in building and operating regulated financial marketplaces across multiple asset classes and geographies. Our MIAX Exchanges, MIAX Futures Exchange and Bermuda Stock Exchange marketplaces are enabled by our in-house built, proprietary technology. We believe the speed and performance of our proprietary technology coupled with our fully integrated, award-winning customer service, sets us apart from our competitors.

Our MIAX Exchange trading platform was originally built to meet the high-performance quoting demands of the U.S. options trading industry. We are regarded as a market leader relative to many of our peers with respect to our technology, based on feedback from our customers. We differentiate our trading platform with our throughput, latency, reliability and wire-order determinism.

We maintain a broad portfolio of U.S. exchange and clearing licenses, in both securities and futures. We operate markets across a diverse number of asset classes including options and cash equities as well as futures and options on futures. Our markets currently include: options on our exchanges regulated by the SEC through MIAX Options, MIAX Pearl, MIAX Emerald, and MIAX Sapphire; U.S. equities through MIAX Pearl Equities — also regulated by the SEC; U.S. futures and options on futures through MIAX Futures Exchange, LLC ("MIAX Futures," formerly the Minneapolis Grain Exchange, LLC (MGEX), which is regulated by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (the "CFTC"); and international listings through The Bermuda Stock Exchange ("BSX"), which is regulated by the Bermuda Monetary Authority (the "BMA"), and The International Stock Exchange Group Limited ("TISEG"), which via its subsidiary, The International Stock Exchange Authority Limited ("TISEA"), is regulated by the Guernsey Financial Services Commission ("GFSC"). We also own Dorman Trading, LLC ("Dorman Trading"), a full-service Futures Commission Merchant ("FCM") registered with the CFTC and the National Futures Association ("NFA").

In July 2024, we entered into a master index services license agreement (the "Bloomberg License Agreement") with Bloomberg Index Services Limited ("Bloomberg") to develop a suite of proprietary products, including index futures, options on futures, and cash index options, based on Bloomberg's portfolio of indexes as agreed to by the parties from time to time (the "Bloomberg Products"). Pursuant to the service schedules under the Bloomberg License Agreement (the "Service Schedules"), we have a ten year exclusive license to list futures, options on futures, and cash-settled index options on (i) the Bloomberg 500 Index (the "B500 Index"), (ii) the Bloomberg US Large Cap Volatility Index (the "B500 Volatility Index") and (iii) the Bloomberg US 100 Price Return Index ("B100Q Index"). We have the exclusive right to list these proprietary products, in North and South America, on any of our affiliated exchanges. We plan to exclusively list certain Bloomberg Products on our exchange in the second quarter of 2026. See "Business — Our Growth Strategy — Creating New Product Offerings" and "Business — Intellectual Property and License Agreements".

Until January 20, 2026, LedgerX LLC d/b/a MIAX Derivatives Exchange ("MIAXdx"), which is regulated by the CFTC with the ability to list for trading fully collateralized U.S. futures, options on futures, and swaps was a wholly-owned subsidiary of ours. Effective as of January 20, 2026, we sold 90% of the issued and outstanding equity of MIAXdx to a joint venture established by Robinhood Markets, Inc. ("Robinhood") in partnership with Susquehanna International Group ("SIG"). We have retained 10% of the issued and outstanding equity of MIAXdx, now known as Rothera Exchange and Clearing LLC ("Rothera") (such transaction, the "MIAXdx Transaction"). Robinhood has announced that its joint venture with SIG will serve FCMs platforms with futures and derivative products, including prediction market contracts. Rothera has announced that it expects to launch its products in the second quarter of 2026.

Since launching our first options exchange in 2012, MIAX has grown to be the 13th largest global derivatives exchange operator as of December 31, 2025, as measured by the total number of futures and options contracts traded on exchanges as reported by the Futures Industry Association (the "FIA"). In 2025, trading in multi-listed U.S. options on our exchanges totaled 2.4 billion contracts, a 41.1% increase from the 2024 total. Total volume of futures and options on futures on the MIAX Futures exchange reached 3.3 million contracts in 2025, a 2.2% increase from the 2024 total. According to data
published by Options Price Reporting Authority ("OPRA"), MIAX Options was ranked second in multi-listed options market share for electronic complex orders in 2024 and 2025.

MIAX has a strong track record of organic growth. By increasing scale and launching new marketplaces, we have been able to substantially grow our transaction volume. Our average daily volume in U.S. options on the MIAX Exchanges in 2025 was 9.5 million contracts as compared to 6.7 million contracts in 2024. This increase represents a compound annual growth rate of 25.3% from our average daily volume of 1.0 million contracts in 2015.

Subsequent to the significant consolidation amongst equity and options exchanges, MIAX's founders saw an opportunity to build a differentiated exchange managed by a team with trading, exchange and technology experience. The founders' vision was to use a technology-first and customer-centric approach to develop faster and more reliable markets for participants.
MIAX was launched with a mission to provide: •marketplaces that cater to the needs of the customer and trading communities;
•competitive pricing based on a low-cost operating structure; •superior customer service and performance; and
•outstanding technology, reliability and risk protections.
We received SEC approval for our first options exchange, MIAX Options, which officially launched in December 2012 with a Pro-Rata allocation model and Customer Rebate pricing structure.

paragraphs: A description of the risks and uncertainties associated with our business is set forth below. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information included in this Annual Report, including the section titled "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Result of Operations" and our consolidated financial statements and the related notes thereto. Our business, results of operations, financial condition, or prospects could also be materially and adversely affected by risks and uncertainties that are not presently known to us or that we currently believe are not material. If any of the risks actually occur, our business, results of operations, financial condition, and prospects could be materially and adversely affected. Some statements in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including statements in the following risk factors, constitute forward-looking statements. Please refer to our note regarding forward-looking statements above.
The following is a summary of some of the key risks and uncertainties associated with our business more fully described below:

•A significant portion of our operating revenues is generated by our transaction and clearing-based business. If the amount of trading volume on our markets or clearing volume decreases, or the product mix shifts to lower revenue products, our revenues less cost of revenues from transaction and clearing fees will most likely decrease.
•Global economic, political and financial market events, government shutdowns and other macro-economic conditions may negatively impact our business.
•Our failure to maintain order flow from our order flow providers could negatively affect our results of operations.
•Revenues from our market data fees and access fees on our MIAX Exchanges may be reduced due to declines in our market share, trading volumes or regulatory changes.

paragraphs: This section presents management's perspective on our financial condition and results of operations. The following discussion and analysis is intended to highlight and supplement data and information presented elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, and should be read in conjunction with the accompanying audited consolidated financial statements and the notes thereto, included in Item 8 in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. It is also intended to provide you with information that will assist you in understanding our consolidated financial statements, the changes in key items in those consolidated financial statements from year to year, and the primary factors that accounted for those changes. To the extent that this discussion describes prior performance, the descriptions relate only to the periods shown, which may not be indicative of our future financial outcomes. In addition to historical information, this discussion contains forward-looking statements that involve risks, uncertainties and assumptions that could cause results to differ materially from management's expectations. Factors that could cause such differences are discussed in the sections titled "Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" and "Item 1A - Risk Factors."

The following discusses financial conditions and results of operations for the year ended December 31, 2025 compared to the year ended December 31, 2024. Discussion of financial conditions and results of operations for the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to the year ended December 31, 2023 can be found in "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" included in the Company's Form 424(b)(4) Prospectus filed with the SEC on December 15, 2025.
We are a technology-driven leader in building and operating regulated financial marketplaces across multiple asset classes and geographies.

We operate markets across a diverse number of asset classes including options, futures and cash equities and are developing a portfolio of new products. Our markets include: options through MIAX Options, MIAX Pearl, MIAX Emerald, and MIAX Sapphire; U.S. equities through MIAX Pearl Equities; U.S. futures and options on futures through MIAX Futures, and international listings through BSX and TISE. We also own Dorman Trading, an FCM. We also trade Hard Red Spring Wheat futures and options on MIAX Futures. Through MIAX Futures Clearing, we also offer clearing services for U.S. futures and options on futures. We also owned MIAXdx, a DCM, and a DCO prior to the disposition of MIAXdx in January 2026.

On January 20, 2026, the Company completed the sale of 90% of the issued and outstanding equity in MIAXdx to a joint venture established by Robinhood Markets, Inc. in partnership with Susquehanna International Group. MIH has retained 10% of the issued and outstanding equity of MIAXdx, now known as Rothera Exchange and Clearing LLC.

The Company determined that MIAXdx met the criteria to be classified as held for sale, and accordingly, its total assets of $41.0 million and total liabilities of $2.8 million are presented separately as assets held for sale and liabilities held for sale, respectively, in the consolidated balance sheet as of December 31, 2025.
The sale of MIAXdx resulted in a gain of approximately $50 million, which was recognized upon closing in January 2026.

On June 5, 2025, MIH, through MIH East completed the TISE Acquisition. Prior to the TISE Acquisition, MIH East owned 29.46% of the issued ordinary share capital in TISEG. The total cash consideration paid for the TISE Acquisition was approximately £51.5 million ($69.7 million).

In August 2025, we raised $396.8 million in gross proceeds from our initial public offering (the "IPO") of 17,250,000 shares of common stock, including the full exercise of the underwriters' option to purchase additional shares.

On August 21, 2024, the Company entered into a five-year loan agreement (the "2029 Senior Secured Term Loan") for an aggregate principal amount of $100 million at a stated interest rate of 12.90% per annum payable quarterly. The Company received net proceeds of $95 million after deducting upfront fees. Prior to the second anniversary of the loan, the lenders, at their sole discretion, could make additional term loans to the Company in an aggregate amount of up to $100 million. The 2029 Senior Secured Term Loan was due to mature on August 21, 2029.

In connection with the 2029 Senior Secured Term Loan, the Company issued to the lenders warrants to purchase up to 2,277,338 and 1,518,226 shares of common stock with an exercise price equal to $7.15 and $8.55 per share, respectively, with an expiration date of August 21, 2032. The warrants included a cashless exercise feature, anti-dilution protection, a put right for unexercised warrants under certain conditions and an automatic exercise requirement immediately prior to expiration.

The warrants provided that at any time following the earlier of (i) an event of default, as defined in the loan agreement, or repayment in full of the 2029 Senior Secured Term Loan and (ii) the sixth anniversary of the loan agreement, the lenders, had the right, but not the obligation, to require the Company to redeem any unexercised portion of the warrants for a purchase price equal to its fair value. The put right terminated upon completion of the Company's IPO in August 2025.

The puttable warrants issued with debt were accounted for as a liability carried at fair value subject to remeasurement at each balance sheet date, with any change in the fair value recognized as a component of non-operating income (expense) in the consolidated statements of operations. A portion of the 2029 Senior Secured Term Loan was attributed to the puttable warrants which at the time of issuance had been valued at $59.5 million. The initial fair value of the puttable warrants was recorded as a debt discount which was being amortized, together with debt issuance costs amounting to $5.8 million, to interest expense using the effective interest method over the life of the loan at an effective interest rate of 52.6%.

As of December 31, 2024, the fair value of the puttable warrants was determined to be $64.2 million. The Company determined the initial and subsequent fair value measurements of the warrant liability using a Black-Scholes valuation model. The rights to put warrants terminated upon completion of the Company's IPO in August 2025. Upon completion of the IPO, the outstanding puttable warrants issued with debt were remeasured at fair value and reclassified to additional paid-in capital in the consolidated balance sheet as of December 31, 2025.

paragraphs: 以下對我們業務的描述應與本年度報表（Form 10-K）其他部分所載資訊一併閱讀，本年度報表（Form 10-K）係針對 2025 年 12 月 31 日結算年度。此描述包含前瞻性陳述，涉及風險與不確定性。實際結果可能與前瞻性陳述中所討論的結果有顯著差異，原因請參閱本年度報表（Form 10-K）中「風險因素」及其他部分所載之因素
本公司為一以科技為驅動力，在多種資產類別與地理區域經營受規範金融市場的領導者。MIAX 交易所、MIAX 期貨交易所與百慕達股票交易所之市場，皆由本公司自建之專屬科技技術所支援。我們相信本公司專屬科技之速度與性能，搭配我們完整整合、獲獎肯定之客戶服務，使我們與競爭對手有所區隔。
MIAX 交易所交易平台最初建置係為滿足美國選擇權交易產業之高性能報價需求。根據客戶之反饋，我們在科技方面被視為相對於許多同業之市場領導者。我們透過交易平台之吞吐量、延遲時間、可靠性與線路訂單確定性，來區隔我們之交易平台。

本公司持有廣泛之美國交易所與結算許可證，涵蓋證券與期貨。我們經營之市場涵蓋多種資產類別，包括選擇權與現金股票，以及期貨與選擇權於期貨之上。本公司目前之市場包括：由美國證券交易委員會（SEC）監管之選擇權市場，包括 MIAX Options、MIAX Pearl、MIAX Emerald 與 MIAX Sapphire；美國股票市場透過 MIAX Pearl Equities（亦由 SEC 監管）；美國期貨與選擇權於期貨市場透過 MIAX Futures Exchange, LLC（"MIAX Futures"，原為明尼阿波利斯穀物交易所 LLC（MGEX），由商品期貨交易委員會（CFTC）監管）；國際上市市場透過百慕達股票交易所（BSX），由百慕達貨幣管理局（BMA）監管，以及國際股票交易所集團有限公司（TISEG），透過其子公司國際股票交易所管理局有限公司（TISEA），由根西金融服務委員會（GFSC）監管。本公司亦擁有 Dorman Trading, LLC（"Dorman Trading"），為一全功能期貨委託經紀商（FCM），已向 CFTC 與國家期貨協會（NFA）註冊。

2024 年 7 月，本公司與 Bloomberg Index Services Limited（"Bloomberg"）簽訂主指數服務許可協議（"Bloomberg License Agreement"），以開發一套專屬產品，包括指數期貨、選擇權於期貨之上，以及現金指數選擇權，基於 Bloomberg 所提供之指數組合，如雙方所同意（"Bloomberg Products"）。根據 Bloomberg License Agreement 之服務排程（"Service Schedules"），本公司取得十年獨家許可，可在（i）Bloomberg 500 指數（"B500 Index"）、（ii）Bloomberg 美國大型股波動指數（"B500 Volatility Index"）以及（iii）Bloomberg 美國 100 價值回報指數（"B100Q Index"）上，上市期貨、選擇權於期貨之上，以及現金結算指數選擇權。本公司在北美與南美地區，於任何本公司關聯交易所，均有獨家權上市這些專屬產品。本公司預計於 2026 年第二季，獨家於本公司交易所上市部分 Bloomberg Products。詳見「業務 — 我們的成長策略 — 創造新產品」與「業務 — 智慧財產權與許可協議」。

截至 2026 年 1 月 20 日為止，LedgerX LLC d/b/a MIAX 衍生品交易所（"MIAXdx"），由 CFTC 監管，具備上市交易完全擔保之美國期貨、選擇權於期貨之上與掉期之能力，為本公司之 wholly-owned 子公司。自 2026 年 1 月 20 日起，本公司將本公司 MIAXdx 90% 已發行與流通之股權出售予由 Robinhood Markets, Inc.（"Robinhood"）與 Susquehanna International Group（"SIG"）共同設立之合資企業。本公司保留 MIAXdx 10% 已發行與流通之股權，現稱為 Rothera 交易所與結算 LLC（"Rothera"）（此交易稱為 "MIAXdx 交易"）。Robinhood 表示其與 SIG 之合資企業將為 FCM 平台提供期貨與衍生品產品，包括預測市場合約。Rothera 表示預計於 2026 年第二季推出其產品。

自2012年推出第一個選擇權交易所以來，MIAX已成長為截至2025年12月31日全球第13大衍生品交易所營運商，此數據以交易所報告的總合約數量為準，由期貨產業協會（the "FIA"）提供。在2025年，我們交易所的多交易所上市美國選擇權交易總計為2.4 十億合約，較2024年的總數增加41.1%。MIAX Futures交易所的期貨與期貨選擇權總交易量在2025年達到3.3 百萬合約，較2024年的總數增加2.2%。根據數據
Options Price Reporting Authority（"OPRA"）所發表之資料，MIAX Options 在 2024 年與 2025 年之多交易所上市選擇權市場電子複雜訂單市場佔有率排名為第二。
MIAX 有強大的內生成長紀錄。透過增加規模並啟動新市場，我們已能大幅成長交易量。我們在 MIAX 交易所的美國選擇權平均每日交易量，2025 年為 9.5 百萬合約，相較於 2024 年的 6.7 百萬合約。此成長代表從 2015 年平均每日交易量為 1.0 百萬合約起，複合成長率為 25.3%。
在股票與選擇權交易所進行重大併購後，MIAX 的創辦人看到機會建立一個與其他交易所有所區別的交易所，由具交易、交易所及科技經驗的團隊管理。創辦人的願景是透過以科技為先、以客戶為中心的策略，為參與者建立更快且更可靠的市場。
MIAX 起步的使命是提供：•符合客戶與交易社羣需求的市場場所；
•基於低成本營運結構的競爭性價格；•優越的客戶服務與表現；以及
•卓越的科技、可靠性與風險防護措施。
我們獲得 SEC 對我們第一個選擇權交易所 MIAX Options 的批准，該交易所於 2012 年 12 月正式啟動，採用比例分配模式與客戶回饋定價結構。

paragraphs: 本節說明管理階層對本公司財務狀況及營運成果的觀點。以下討論與分析旨在強調並補充本年度10-K申報表其他處所呈現的資料與資訊，應與隨附的審計過的合併財務報表及其附註一併閱讀，包含於本年度10-K申報表第8項。本討論亦旨在提供協助您理解本公司合併財務報表、那些合併財務報表中關鍵項目年度變動情形，以及導致這些變動的主要因素之資訊。若本討論描述過去的表現，則所述內容僅與所顯示之期間有關，未必反映本公司未來財務結果。除歷史資訊外，本討論包含涉及風險、不確定性與假設之展望性陳述，這些因素可能導致結果與管理階層預期有重大差異。導致此等差異的因素於「特別注意展望性陳述」及「第1A項－風險因素」節中討論。
以下討論為2025年12月31日財務年度與2024年12月31日財務年度之財務狀況與營運成果比較。2024年12月31日財務年度與2023年12月31日財務年度之財務狀況與營運成果討論，請參閱包含於本公司Form 424(b)(4)發行說明書中，於2025年12月15日提交至SEC之「管理階層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」。
本公司為一以科技為驅動力，在多種資產類別與地理區域經營受規範金融市場之領導者。

本公司經營多種資產類別之市場，包括選擇權、期貨與現金股票，並正在開發一組新產品。本公司市場包括：透過MIAX Options、MIAX Pearl、MIAX Emerald與MIAX Sapphire提供選擇權；透過MIAX Pearl Equities提供美國股票；透過MIAX Futures提供美國期貨與期貨選擇權；透過BSX與TISE提供國際上市。本公司亦擁有Dorman Trading，為一FCM。本公司亦於MIAX Futures交易Hard Red Spring Wheat期貨與期貨選擇權。透過MIAX Futures Clearing，本公司亦提供美國期貨與期貨選擇權之清算服務。本公司於2026年1月處分MIAXdx前，亦擁有MIAXdx，為一DCM與DCO。
於2026年1月20日，本公司完成將MIAXdx已發行與流通之股權90%出售給由Robinhood Markets, Inc.與Susquehanna International Group合作設立之合資企業。MIH保留MIAXdx已發行與流通之股權10%，現稱為Rothera Exchange and Clearing LLC。
本公司判定 MIAXdx 達成符合列為待售資產之標準，因此，其總資產 41.0 百萬美元及總負債 2.8 百萬美元分別以待售資產及待售負債列示於 2025 年 12 月 31 日之合併資產負債表中。
MIAXdx之出售產生約50 百萬美元之獲利，於2026年1月交易完成時認列。
於 2025 年 6 月 5 日，MIH 透過 MIH East 完成 TISE 收購。在 TISE 收購前，MIH East 持有 TISEG 已發行普通股資本的 29.46%。TISE 收購總現金對價約為 £51.5 百萬（$69.7 百萬）
2025 年 8 月，本公司透過首次公開發行（the "IPO"）發行 17,250,000 股普通股，籌得 gross proceeds 為 396.8 百萬美元，包含經承銷商行使選擇權後購買額外股份的全部金額。

2024 年 8 月 21 日，本公司與貸款人簽訂五年期貸款協議（the "2029 Senior Secured Term Loan"），貸款總本金為 100 百萬美元，年利率為 12.90%，每季支付一次利息。本公司收到淨資金為 95 百萬美元，扣除 upfront fees 後。貸款到期前第二個紀念日，貸款人可自行決定向本公司追加貸款，總額最高為 100 百萬美元。2029 Senior Secured Term Loan 貸款於 2029 年 8 月 21 日到期。
配合 2029 Senior Secured Term Loan，本公司向貸款人發行認購權證，可購買最多 2,277,338 股及 1,518,226 股普通股，認購價格分別為每股市價 7.15 美元及 8.55 美元，權證到期日為 2032 年 8 月 21 日。權證包含無現金行使機制、反稀釋保護、特定條件下未行使權證的 put right，以及到期前自動行使要求。
權證規定，自貸款協議中所定義的違約事件或貸款償還完畢後，以及貸款協議第六週年後，貸款人有權但無義務要求本公司以公平價值購回未行使的權證。put right 在本公司 2025 年 8 月完成 IPO 後終止。

與債務發行一同發行的 puttable 權證被列為負債，按公平價值計價，並在每個財務報表日重新衡量，公平價值變動計入綜合損益表的非營運收入（費用）中。2029 Senior Secured Term Loan 中一部分被歸屬於 puttable 權證，發行時該權證價值為 59.5 百萬美元。puttable 權證的初始公平價值被記錄為債務折扣，與發行費用 5.8 百萬美元一同按有效利率法，以 52.6% 有效利率攤銷至貸款期間的利息費用中。

截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，puttable 權證的公平價值被評估為 64.2 百萬美元。本公司使用 Black-Scholes 評值模型評估 puttable 權證的初始及後續公平價值。puttable 權證在本公司 2025 年 8 月完成 IPO 後終止。IPO 完成後，與債務發行一同發行的 outstanding puttable 權證按公平價值重新衡量，並於 2025 年 12 月 31 日的綜合財務報表中重新歸類至資本額中。

本公司普通股相關風險
全球總體經濟、政治及金融市場事件或情勢可能對本公司業務產生負面影響。
全球貿易政策，包括對進口商品課徵關稅及其他課稅措施，可能對本公司業務產生重大負面影響。
本公司若無法維持來自訂單流提供者之訂單流，可能對本公司營運成果產生負面影響。
本公司 MIAX 交易所之市場資料費用、存取費用及其他非交易費用之收入，可能因市場佔有率、交易量下降或法規變動而減少。
本公司面臨激烈競爭。若本公司無法成功競爭，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生重大負面影響。
本公司業務可能因價格競爭而受到不利影響。
其他場所對本公司專有產品的競爭可能對本公司營業收入產生負面影響。
本公司依賴高階管理團隊成員及其他關鍵人員。
本公司依賴具高度專業技能且具本行業經驗之員工，若無法吸引及留住這些高度專業技能員工，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及未來成長產生不利影響。
第三方所遭遇之財務或其他問題可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
本公司成本結構主要為固定成本。若本公司營業收入下降且無法降低成本，將對本公司獲利產生不利影響。
本公司面臨與清算成員違約及流動性風險相關之風險。
MIAX Futures 清算所可能在結算日產生大量信用風險。
結算銀行系統故障可能對 MIAX Futures 交割機構同時造成信用風險與流動性風險。
Dorman Trading 需要根據短暫通知提供擔保資金。
Dorman Trading 面臨其資金及客戶資金所存放之金融機構違約的風險。
Dorman Trading 的風險管理政策與程序可能使其暴露於未識別或未預見的風險，這可能會損害其業務。
我們可能無法成功推出新服務或產品，包括 Bloomberg Products 或其他專屬產品，以及支援這些產品之技術。
paragraphs: 本公司業務所涉及之風險與不確定性說明如下。請謹慎考量下列所說明之風險與不確定性，並配合本年度財務報告中所有其他資訊，包括標題為「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」之部分，以及我們之合併財務報表及其相關附註。本公司之業務、營運成果、財務狀況或前景，亦可能因目前尚未為本公司所知悉，或本公司目前認為不具重大影響之風險與不確定性而受到重大且不利之影響。若任何風險實際發生，本公司之業務、營運成果、財務狀況與前景，可能受到重大且不利之影響。本年度10-K表報中之部分陳述，包括下列風險因素中之陳述，屬於前瞻性陳述。請參閱我們關於前瞻性陳述之說明。
以下為本公司業務所涉及之部分關鍵風險與不確定性之摘要，完整說明請參閱下文：
•本公司營運收入之重大部分來自交易與清算業務。若本公司市場之交易量或清算量減少，或產品組成轉變為收入較低之產品，則本公司之收入減去交易與清算費用之成本，很可能會減少。
•全球經濟、政治與金融市場事件、政府停擺及其他總體經濟條件，可能對本公司業務造成負面影響。
•本公司未能維持來自訂單流提供者之訂單流，可能對本公司營運成果造成負面影響。
•本公司MIAX交易所之市場資料費用與存取費用收入，可能因市場佔有率、交易量下降或法規變動而減少。
